simple.summary: חָרֵב (chârêb) means parched or ruined First listed occurrence: Ezek 36 35.

definitions.full: H2720. chareb I. [ חָרֵב ] adjective dry , only feminine singular חֲרֵבָה Lev 7:10 of meal-offering not moistened (with oil; P); חֲרֵבָה מַּתֿ Prov 17:1 a dry morsel . II. חָרֵב adjective waste, desolate ; — masculine singular absolute ׳ח Jer 33:10 3 t.; feminine singular חֲרֵבָה Neh 2:3 2 t.; feminine plural הֶחֳרֵבוֺת Ezek 36:35 , 38 (see Kö i. 241 ); — of a city, defined בְּהֵמָה וּמֵאֵין אָדָם מֵאֵין Jer 33:10 , compare 33:12 ; also Neh 2:3 , 17 ; הֶחֳרֵבוֺת הֶעָרִים Ezek 36:35 (+ הַנֶּהֱרָסוֺת הַנְשַׁמּוֺת, ; opposed to יָשָׁב֑וּ בְּצוּרוֺת ).
